# Noto Emoji

`icons/fruit/*.png` are unmodified 128px PNGs from Google's Noto Emoji
(https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji, `2D/png/128/`).

The project README states that its image resources are under the Apache License 2.0,
while the repository's LICENSE file is the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (included here).
Both permit use and redistribution in this app. Google and Noto are trademarks of Google LLC;
this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
